source: PubChem (NIH, National Library of Medicine), its periodic table: pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/periodictable/JSON, retrieved 2026-11-14 — names (in IUPAC spelling: aluminium, caesium), category (its group block), ground-state electron configuration, Pauling electronegativity, common oxidation states, standard state, melting and boiling points (K), density (g/cm³), first ionization energy and electron affinity (eV), van der Waals radius (pm), year of discovery. Standard atomic weights: CIAAW, abridged standard atomic weights (2021), ciaaw.org/abridged-atomic-weights.htm, retrieved 2026-11-14; an element without one shows the mass number of the isotope PubChem gives (its longest-lived).
